Name: HD Sprites (Unofficial update 1.6)
Author: Shadow00666
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Upscales Stardew Valley's textures to 2x resolution using a  custom pixel-art scaler Originally created by ninthworld, this version has been updated to work on Stardew Valley 1.6 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder. The mod is 200mb because of the assets 
3. Launch the game once through SMAPI
4.when loading your save file it will take sometime so wait patiently 

As of HD Sprites to add a content pack to this mod, follow these instructions. Content pack must contain PNG images and be compatible with Content Patcher.

1. Find the content pack you want to work with this mod in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
2. Open that content pack's manifest.json file and copy its UniqueID entry.
3. Open the HD Sprites config.json file and paste that UniqueID under the LoadContentPacks section so that it looks something like this:

"LoadContentPacks": {
    "Elle.SeasonalBuildings": true,
}

That's it! Just run the modded game like normal and your content packs should appear as normal - anything set from the pack's own content.json or config.json will also be applied to the upscaled version automatically.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Upscales game textures to 2x resolution
- Built-in conditional token system (season, weather, day of week, player state, and more) so texture packs can define variants that swap dynamically as the game changes

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
